description:
About the job

About Turn

Turn is a venture-backed B2B software company built for the realities of high-volume hiring. Our platform runs pre-employment background checks and continuous monitoring, and integrates directly into the systems employers already hire with — so teams in hospitality, staffing, construction, healthcare, and real estate can screen candidates fast without giving up compliance. We’re a small, fully remote team that moves quickly and ships real things.




About the Role

We’re looking for a hands-on Growth Marketing Engineer to own our full-funnel demand engine and turn the traffic and buying signals we already generate into qualified demos and pipeline.

You’ll sit at the intersection of performance marketing, marketing operations, conversion optimization, and analytics, building and running the systems that move a prospect from first touch to booked meeting. This is a builder’s role: you’ll spend your days in the ad platforms, the CRM, the analytics tools, and the page builder, shipping changes and measuring their impact on qualified-demo volume and pipeline.




What You’ll Do
Paid acquisition: Plan, launch, and optimize paid campaigns (Google Ads — Performance Max and Search, LinkedIn), architecting campaign structure, audience targeting, and conversion-event mapping so spend optimizes toward booked demos and pipeline rather than clicks, with clean, server-imported conversion tracking (enhanced/offline conversions from the CRM).
Conversion rate optimization: Build and A/B test dedicated demo landing pages, landing pages, forms, and CTAs that turn visitors into meetings, including persona-aware routing (buyer vs. candidate vs. partner) across the site, and own the on-site demo path.
Marketing operations & RevOps: Own the full lead lifecycle and the automation behind it — CRM workflows, lifecycle-stage instrumentation, lead scoring and routing, and the visitor-signal-to-outbound engine across HubSpot, Amplemarket, RB2B, Duo, and Zapier. Build and scale the loop that turns identified in-market website visitors into timely, signal-based 1:1 outreach.
Email deliverability & infrastructure: Own outbound sending infrastructure — mailbox and domain strategy, warm-up and rotation, pre-send verification, and deliverability health — so outreach lands in the inbox and protects the primary domain’s reputation.
Analytics & reporting: Build and own the measurement layer end to end — define the key conversion events, GA4, UTM governance, conversion validation — and build the dashboards that tie marketing activity to pipeline and revenue (Mode).
Conversion copywriting: Write the ad, landing-page, and signal-based outbound copy that drives response.




What You’ll Need
Hands-on experience across growth marketing, demand generation, marketing operations, or revenue operations — ideally in B2B SaaS. You’re a builder who works inside the tools, not only a strategist.
Real performance-marketing experience, especially Google Ads (including Performance Max and Search campaign structure), with a habit of optimizing toward CAC and pipeline instead of vanity metrics.
Fluency with a modern marketing / CRM automation stack (we use HubSpot, Amplemarket, RB2B, Intercom, Zapier, and Calendly; comparable tools like Salesforce, Marketo, or Make are fine).
Analytics chops: GA4, disciplined UTM and conversion tracking, and enough SQL / BI to build your own dashboards (we use Mode; Looker, Amplitude, or similar is fine).
CRO instincts and conversion copywriting ability.
A data-driven, experimental, self-directed way of working — you read the funnel, ship the fix, and measure the result.
Bilingual Spanish/English, with fluent written English.




This is our ideal profile, not a checklist. If you can do the work, we’d love to hear from you regardless of years or title.




Success Metrics (First 6–12 Months)
Growth in qualified demos and marketing-sourced pipeline, at flat or lower cost per acquisition.
Higher conversion rates across the funnel, from visitor to demo to booked meeting.
A larger share of best-fit (ICP) traffic reached and converted.
Strong outbound deliverability and healthy sending infrastructure across all domains.
A reliable weekly reporting cadence that ties marketing activity to pipeline.




Nice to Have
Experience in HR tech, workforce, background screening, or compliance-adjacent categories.
Account-based marketing (ABM) and audience segmentation.
Server-side, enhanced, or offline conversion tracking (e.g. CAPI).
Outbound email deliverability at scale — multi-domain/mailbox management, warm-up, and inbox placement.
Technical SEO and simple creative for ads and social.




Perks & Compensation
Competitive salary (base range shared early in the process)
Major medical health insurance
Paid time off
Remote work with occasional in-office training and in-person meeting

About the job

Description

We are looking for a Sr. Social and Creators Product Manager for the Amazon Mexico business to drive growth for the Amazon Mexico Stores via automated (performance) marketing channels.

We are looking for a marketing leader who likes to use technology to improve the customer experience and make a meaningful difference to how our customers shop online. At Amazon, we aim to become Earth’s most Customer-Centric Company and continue to innovate the way we engage with our customers through various marketing programs.

Critical missions of Paid Social and Creators team in Mexico are 1) to drive traffic and create innovative marketing programs in existing channels to make Amazon the most preferred shopping and entertainment destination for customers in Mexico, 2) to provide the best-in-class customer experience with highly personalized engaging marketing programs to help our customers make purchasing decisions, 3) to educate and attract new customers to Amazon overall and specific offerings, and 4) to dive deep into data to gain insights and optimize marketing programs.

The Sr. Social and Creators Product Manager plays a critical role in realizing these missions, leading various online marketing functions for Amazon.com.mx, managing and improving the marketing programs in Social Media Advertising and Creators Marketing. They will also be responsible for driving innovation by owning internally developed automated marketing products and platforms by leveraging the Amazon’s technologies. This position is one of the key senior roles in the Mexico Marketing and Prime organization. The impact of this role is significant, accounting for a large percentage of all amazon.com.mx new customers, traffic and sales. The position reports to the Head of Automated Marketing for Amazon Mexico.

Key job responsibilities


 Lead formulation of Social and Creators strategies for Mexico, including identifying key target customer segments, competitive environment, our program’s strengths and areas to invest for future innovations
 Manage, improve and innovate marketing programs, such as Automated Invoicing solutions, Social Ads, creators products.
 Drive topline while managing marketing budget, meeting ROI criteria.
 Deliver results and help Amazon meet or exceed goals in sales, profitability, new customers, and various high-value Amazon programs such as Prime membership.
 Work directly with tech teams across Amazon to define and get new development projects on tech roadmap
 Develop strong relationships and work collaboratively with the category leadership to achieve shared goals.
 Work closely with central Automated Marketing stakeholders and technical resources to ensure the company’s infrastructure, architecture, and site features support and enhance the effectiveness of Automated Marketing team’s programs.
 Identify the unique opportunities and challenges in Mexico by leveraging learnings from customer insights
 Share and learn worldwide best practices to mutually help worldwide marketing teams achieve goals.


About The Team

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications


 7+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
 Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
 Experience with end to end product delivery
 Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
 Experience as a product manager or owner
 Experience owning technology products
 Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
 Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
 Experience in delivering end-to-end customer research studies, including study design, fieldwork (qualitative research moderation and survey execution), analysis, recommendations, reporting and presentation of results to senior leadership


Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

About the job
This job is sourced from a job board. Learn More

FIKI está buscando jóvenes que quieran formarse con nosotros — Programa Jóvenes Construyendo el Futuro **** En FIKI creemos que el mejor talento se forma haciendo.

Por eso abrimos espacios de capacitación dentro de nuestra agencia a través del programa Jóvenes Construyendo el Futuro de la Secretaría del Trabajo (STPS).

Si tienes entre 18 y 29 años, actualmente terminaste tus estudios y no estas laborando, y quieres aprender de verdad cómo funciona una agencia creativa por dentro — esto es para ti.

¿Qué es el programa?

Es una beca del Gobierno de México que te da: - $9,582 pesos mensuales durante 12 meses (depositados directo a ti) - Seguro médico del IMSS (enfermedades, maternidad y riesgos de trabajo) - Constancia oficial de capacitación al terminar - Experiencia real en una agencia que trabaja con marcas en México y Estados Unidos Áreas de capacitación disponibles en FIKI: Marketing y gestión de cuentas Producción audiovisual y edición de video Administración y gestión Ecommerce Lo que vas a hacer: Vas a participar en proyectos reales, acompañando al equipo en actividades de planeación, ejecución y entrega.

Aprenderás procesos, herramientas y formas de trabajo de una agencia que opera con estándares internacionales.

Lo que buscamos: - Tener entre 18 y 29 años cumplidos - No estar dado de alta en IMSS por una institución educativa, ni trabajar formalmente al momento de inscribirte - Ganas reales de aprender (no buscamos experiencia previa, buscamos actitud) - Disponibilidad de 6 horas diarias, 5 días a la semana, durante 12 meses - Modalidad presencial con base en Monterrey (Constituyentes del 57 *****, Pablo A. de La Garza, *****) Puedes enviar tu CV y portafolio a ******

description:
About the job

At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.




Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.




When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.




Marketing Content Specialist at BairesDev




In this role, you'll develop, validate, and optimize the content and data that power the enterprise, ensuring accurate, compelling, and client-focused materials for commercial teams. Combining strategic thinking, AI-powered content creation, and cross-functional collaboration, you'll uncover valuable project insights and improve the quality of our data.

- Produce content including presentation outlines.

- Curate data through research, context gathering, and organized storage.

- Build and manage systems for content intake, processing, and optimization.

- Maintain documentation, guidelines, and content libraries.

- Monitor online reputation and brand presence.

- 3+ years of experience producing B2B marketing content.

- 2+ years of experience in B2B or tech roles.

- 1+ year of experience with AI tool usage and integration.

- 1+ year of experience in the technology industry.

- Advanced proficiency in English.




Nice to have:




- 1+ year of experience writing about technology.




How we do make your work (and your life) easier:




- 100% remote work (from anywhere).

- Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred

- Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.

- Flexible hours: create your own schedule.

- Paid parental leaves, vacations, and holidays.

- Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.

- Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.




Apply now and become part of a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

title: Experto de Categoría - Joyería de oro y plata
skills: Pricing de la categoría: definir precio de venta, rangos de oferta y hasta dónde baja una pieza, siempre con fuente y racional documentado —precio spot de oro y plata, tipo de cambio, ley y gramaje, y comparables de mercado para las piezas que valen más que su metal.
Desarrollar las colecciones de Oro Dondé: definir qué piezas las integran, a qué precio y cómo se presentan, a partir de lo que se mueve en la red y en los canales digitales.
Aportar el criterio de valor que sustenta las ofertas de préstamo sobre oro y plata, en coordinación con valuación.
Activar la categoría en todos los canales: qué se empuja, cuándo, en qué canal y con qué argumento.
Colaborar estrechamente con la red de sucursales: resolver la duda difícil, dar criterio en las piezas que escalan y formar a quienes las reciben.

Definir los lineamientos digitales de la categoría: matriz de datos y atributos obligatorios (metal, ley, peso, tipo de pieza, piedras, hechura, contrastes, estado) y el estándar de cómo se describe y se fotografía cada pieza —contrastes, cierres, engastes, peso en báscula, marcas de uso reales.
Dejar la categoría lista para comercio agéntico: nomenclatura, atributos y contenido consistentes para que un agente entienda y venda la pieza, y corregir lo que la IA propone mal.
Curar el inventario: qué empujar, qué reprecificar, qué se estancó, qué vale más como pieza que como metal y qué no volver a tomar.
Leer el pulso del mercado: el precio del metal, qué tipo de pieza se mueve, cuál se estanca y por qué, qué estilos y marcas ganan y pierden tracción.
Ser la referencia de la categoría: el criterio final cuando algo no cuadra. Decir “no” a una pieza también es parte del trabajo.
Identificar pieza por pieza: metal y ley (10k, 14k, 18k, 22k; plata .925, .950, .999), peso, tipo de pieza, hechura, contrastes y marcas de fabricante, piedras y engaste, estado.
Verificar la ley con piedra de toque y ácidos, densidad, imán y XRF cuando aplica, y leer los resultados con criterio.

Detectar lo que no es lo que parece: chapa, gold filled y vermeil vendidos como oro sólido; alpaca o plata alemana como plata; piezas huecas o rellenas, soldaduras de baja ley, contrastes falsos, piedras sintéticas o simulantes.
Separar el valor de fundición del valor de pieza: cuándo una joya vale por gramos y ley, y cuándo vale más por firma, diseño, época o piedras.
Saber qué se resuelve en taller, qué escala a valuación formal o a gemología y qué no se toma.
Perfil joyero: experiencia en joyería, taller u orfebrería, marca o retail de joyería. Los años importan menos que lo que sabes.
Criterio de producto: saber armar una colección que se vende, no solo valuar piezas sueltas.
Pasión por la categoría. Sigues el precio del metal, el diseño, las marcas y el mercado de segunda mano.
Criterio y honestidad para poner un precio, defenderlo y rechazar una pieza cuando no cuadra.

Piso analítico: Excel sólido, disciplina para documentar el sustento de cada precio y capacidad de explicar con números qué funciona y qué no. No buscamos un analista ni un perfil de e-commerce: eso ya está cubierto.
Capacidad de trabajar con áreas distintas —sucursales, valuación, capacitacion, digital—
Suman: certificación en valuación de joyería o gemología, inglés para fuentes internacionales.

Job Type: Full-time




Location: Remote




Job Summary:

You will handle customer complaints and inquiries, manage tickets, and expertly de-escalate conflicts, all while thriving in a dynamic remote environment. If you are driven, adaptable, and passionate about community engagement, we want you on our extended team.

• Respond promptly to customer complaints and questions across multiple channels.

• De-escalate conflicts and turn challenging interactions into positive outcomes.

• Monitor community activities and proactively identify potential issues or opportunities.

• Collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure customer needs are met and feedback is shared.

• Maintain clear documentation of all community interactions and ticket histories.

• Foster a positive, inclusive, and engaging community environment.




Required Skills and Qualifications:

• Demonstrated experience in customer support or community management roles.

• Expertise in conflict de-escalation and crisis management.

• Proficient with ticket management systems and support tools.

• Strong ability to manage time, prioritize tasks, and work independently in a fully remote setting.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Energetic, resourceful, and solution-oriented mindset.

• Proven track record of providing exceptional customer experiences.




Preferred Qualifications:

• Prior experience working in distributed or remote teams.

About the job

Company Description

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you’ll find your purpose here.

Job Description

Primary Function of Position:

Financial analysts are responsible for providing analytical support. In this position you will support the execution of all operational accounting and financial reporting activities; partnering with Corporate Accounting to ensure compliance with GAAP and internal accounting policies and procedures to minimize and/or eliminate control deficiencies

Responsible for monthly and quarterly close processes as it relates to operational accounting procedures and ensuring internal controls are met; work cross-functionally with corporate accounting and global operations FP&A partners.

Analyzing results; monitoring variances; identifying trends; recommending actions to management.
Monitor performance relative to plan, by developing and reporting key financial metrics.
Identify key opportunities and risks within financial models.
Lead / support key transversal projects around general process improvement, reporting tools and cost efficiency. 
Prioritize requests to establish and deliver upon stakeholder expectations.
Coordinate data and reporting required for internal accounting reviews.
Support projects and key initiatives as determined with finance leadership.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

About the job

About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

Business Analysts at Nubank

As a company at the forefront of the financial revolution in Brazil, Nubank has experienced exponential growth since its inception. To keep your growth path healthy, numerous critical decisions constantly need to be made. Business Analysts are fundamental in the decision process because they must not only be able to deal with large amounts of information and data, but also always think of ways to improve our clients' experience.

It is BA's responsibility to structure the data, analyze it and use the results to test different solutions with the aim of improving Nubank's efficiency.

We are looking for people who are independent and who are not afraid to take the initiative to identify and solve problems that are not necessarily obvious.

You can read more about it in our blog and get some insights into how we work.

As a Business Analyst, You’re Expected To


Do a lot of investigative work, focused on deciding which data makes the most sense to use in which situation. If you don't have the data, it's your job to think about what tests can be done or how to extract the information you need to answer your questions;
Support your team in making data-based decisions by monitoring analysis and decisions, ensuring the flow of projects and making the process of taking risks comfortable despite the uncertainties;

Understand our products and interactions with other areas;
Take advantage of opportunities to grow and learn from a well-prepared and highly qualified team;
Opportunity to work in a complex, dynamic and diverse environment, participating in projects that will impact a large number of clients.

Analytical capacity: ease with numbers and calculations, having the ability to solve problems mathematically;
Business basics: dynamics between risks and opportunities, as well as interaction between business areas and technical areas (products/engineering);
Problem solving: ease and creativity to seek solutions to day-to-day challenges and achieve the best results;

We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer.

We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location.

So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude.

This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization.

About The Role

Fable Core is the backend, infrastructure, and platform team behind Fable – a social reading product now part of Scribd, Inc. Fable is a leading platform for everything related to books and reading: find your next book, join a book club, build a reading habit. We care deeply about building a great experience for our growing community of 1M+ monthly active users. The Fable app has often been featured in the App Store, both as App Of The Day and the Essential Book Apps list.

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Fable Core team, you will set technical direction for the Fable backend and own the reliability and health of the platform that powers the product. You will partner with product, design, ML, and infrastructure partners to turn ambiguous product intent into durable backend systems, lead incident response end-to-end, and raise the ceiling for the team through design leadership and mentorship. We are a small team with broad scope - every position on the team is high-impact.

Our stack: Python/Django, Postgres, Kubernetes, Datadog, GCP / AWS.

What You’ll Do


Set technical direction for the Fable backend – write and socialize technical design documents, drive architecture reviews, and turn ambiguous product intent into concrete backend design.
Own backend reliability and platform health, including staging, CI/CD, databases, queues, cost, and observability.
Lead incident response and drive durable postmortems – write the doc, run the meeting, and make sure action items actually ship.
Be the Fable backend voice in cross-team planning and the glue in cross-functional execution.
Raise the ceiling for the team through PR review, mentorship, pairing, and by setting a high bar on design, testing, and ops.
Build and evolve the Fable backend platform so the team can ship faster and more safely.
Bring agentic engineering practices into the team’s day-to-day work and help the team adopt them effectively.


We’re Looking for Someone With


10+ years of backend experience, including meaningful time in Python/Django and at least one other stack (Go, Node, Java/Kotlin, or similar).
Experience operating production systems on a major cloud – OLTP databases at scale, container orchestration, queueing, and CI/CD.
A track record of owning incidents end-to-end, including the follow-through.
The ability to write a Technical Design Document (TDD) that a staff peer trusts and a product lead can understand, and to turn ambiguous product intent into concrete backend design.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills – you hold your own with senior PM, design, and ML partners, and you care more about the system landing than about being right.
A pragmatic default paired with a strong systems instinct – you look for root causes, not symptoms.
Hands-on experience with agentic engineering tools and workflows in a real production setting.


Nice to Have


Experience with subscription and entitlements systems (Stripe, RevenueCat, App Store / Play billing).
Experience leading a platform or infra function through a migration (on-prem→cloud, AWS↔GCP, monolith→services, or similar).
Experience working alongside ML teams on recommendation or feed systems.

title: Queue Specialist
skills: Queue Performance & Operational Coverage
Monitor ticket queue performance throughout the day and identify emerging service-level, capacity, and coverage risks.
Coordinate with support leaders and technical teams to rebalance workload, adjust routing, and address volume spikes, absences, and major incidents.
Track staffing coverage and agent availability against demand and promptly communicate gaps or schedule risks to the appropriate leaders.
Maintain queue operating procedures, prioritization rules, routing standards, escalation paths, and customer communication requirements.
Drive follow-up on unassigned, aging, stalled, or at-risk work until ownership and next actions are confirmed.
Provide real-time operational guidance and recommendations without direct supervisory or performance-management responsibility.
Ticket Queue Management & Case Progression
Maintain operational visibility into ticket volume, unassigned work, backlog, aging, severity mix, assignment status, SLA performance, and customer update compliance.
Prioritize P1/P2 incidents, aging P3/P4 tickets, stalled cases, repeat contacts, reopened tickets, and work at risk of breaching service commitments.
Coordinate ticket assignment and rebalancing based on priority, skill, workload, geography, customer impact, and coverage.
Review tickets for complete issue details, business impact, troubleshooting history, evidence, ownership, status, and next-update commitments.
Conduct daily queue reviews and coordinate corrective action when progress, documentation, ownership, or customer communication does not meet standards.
Identify and help resolve assignment gaps, duplicate tickets, routing errors, workflow failures, and other barriers to timely case progression.
Escalation, Communication & Operational Coordination
Serve as the operational coordination point for queue risk, ownership gaps, priority questions, and cross-functional follow-up.
Ensure urgent and high-impact issues are escalated promptly to Incident Management, Technical Support, subject matter experts, or leadership using defined criteria.
Apply warm-handoff standards covering priority, impact, symptoms, timeline, diagnostics, evidence, current status, customer expectations, and next action.
Provide concise operational reporting on ticket backlog, SLA risk, coverage, escalations, and major service events.
Monitor customer update commitments and coordinate follow-up when communications are overdue or incomplete.
Represent queue operations in service reviews, post-incident reviews, and improvement initiatives as requested.
Performance Monitoring & Continuous Improvement
Monitor compliance with ticket workflows, SLAs, escalation requirements, documentation standards, and audit expectations.
Track and report measures such as first-contact resolution, ticket response time, backlog aging, reopen rate, update compliance, quality scores, and customer satisfaction.
Analyze demand trends, repeat contacts, misrouted tickets, escalation delays, knowledge gaps, and capacity constraints to identify improvement opportunities.
Maintain queue dashboards, operating procedures, routing guidance, and reporting materials.
Coordinate corrective and preventive actions with process owners, technical teams, and stakeholders and track improvements through measurable outcomes.
Recommend tools, automation, routing, workflow, self-service, and coverage improvements that increase responsiveness and customer experience.
7+ years of service desk, technical support, call center, or ticket operations experience.
Demonstrated experience monitoring or coordinating high-volume ticket queues in a 24x7 or extended-hours support environment.
Experience with real-time queue monitoring, workload balancing, ticket assignment, SLA tracking, and escalation coordination.
Strong knowledge of incident prioritization, ticket lifecycle management, routing, documentation, escalation, and customer communication.
Ability to interpret ticket and operational metrics, identify trends and service risks, and recommend corrective actions.
Experience using case-management, reporting, and knowledge-management platforms.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence action across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Sound judgment under pressure and the ability to make timely operational decisions during high-volume periods and critical incidents.
Strong organizational, analytical, conflict-resolution, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and maintain attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to support nights, weekends, holidays, and non-traditional schedules as operational needs require.
3+ years leading technical support teams or queue management.
Bachelor's degree in information technology, business, communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
ITIL, HDI, contact-center, or workforce-management certification.
Experience with enterprise telephony, automatic call distribution, or workforce-management platforms.
Experience supporting business-critical, technical, or industrial environments.
Experience improving queue performance through workflow automation, skill-based routing, self-service, analytics, or knowledge-centered support practices.

About the job

¡Forma parte de la revolución financiera que está cambiando México!




¿Qué harás como Analista de datos?




Buscamos un Analista de datos quien será responsable de garantizar la continuidad y eficiencia operativa mediante el monitoreo en tiempo real de indicadores clave, la gestión y seguimiento de incidencias técnicas en aplicativos internos y la coordinación estratégica entre distintas áreas para asegurar el cumplimiento de objetivos operativos y comerciales.

Este rol actúa como punto central de visibilidad operativa, anticipando desviaciones, identificando riesgos en la operación y coordinando acciones inmediatas que permitan mantener la estabilidad del negocio y la experiencia del cliente.

La posición representa una excelente oportunidad para perfiles analíticos interesados en desarrollar experiencia en operaciones, análisis de datos y toma de decisiones en tiempo real dentro de un entorno dinámico y de alto crecimiento.




RESPONSABILIDADES

Monitoreo operativo en tiempo real

Supervisar continuamente el desempeño operativo, identificando desviaciones en indicadores clave antes de que impacten la operación o los objetivos del área. Detectar oportunamente incidencias operativas y dar seguimiento en tiempo real.

Our client is an AI-powered personal growth and mentoring company focused on helping people make better decisions, gain clarity, and create meaningful change. description:
About the job

E-Commerce Growth Marketing Manager — TikTok Shop & Social Commerce

https://docs.google.com/document/d/15jwx8ef5lVFGH8VYS8LljPTq6vrZY_aQ6JMxIqgrqQA/edit?usp=sharing




Remote | Full-time | 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern (flexible, we care about results, not clocks) | Fluent English required

Salary: $2000 to $2200 USD/month based on experience + profit sharing bonuses based on performance.




About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a women-owned NYC eyewear brand growing fast, building luxury sunglasses that solve real problems: floating sunnies, tangle-free aviators, foldable pocket frames, and mood-boosting lenses. We are a small, close-knit team where everyone wears many hats, supports each other, and jumps in wherever needed.




The Role

We are looking for an E-Commerce Growth Marketing Manager to turn TopFoxx’s digital marketing and e-commerce channels into scalable, profitable growth engines.

TikTok Shop is a major focus, but this is not a TikTok-only position. You will work across TikTok Shop, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Instagram, creative strategy, paid media, website conversion, and broader e-commerce marketing. We need someone who understands how these pieces connect and can execute, analyze, and drive results.




You should be able to receive a problem like “TikTok Shop isn’t performing. Figure out what’s happening.” and independently investigate the data, identify the problems, develop a strategy, implement solutions, monitor results, and improve. The same applies to “Meta ROAS dropped” or “Traffic is high but conversion is low.”




You do not need to be an expert in everything. You need to be curious, capable, hands-on, and willing to figure things out. This is not a role where you simply report performance and wait for direction. We are looking for someone who owns growth.




What Success Looks Like

Grow TopFoxx's revenue, conversion, and profitability across digital marketing and e-commerce while making TikTok Shop a major growth engine.

Understand → Identify → Strategize → Execute → Measure → Optimize → Scale

We want someone who connects what customers see, where they come from, what creators produce, how products are presented, what makes someone buy, and whether that sale actually made money.

TikTok Shop is a major part of this role. We currently receive about 2,000 affiliate videos a month from roughly 650 creators, and only 1–2% drive sales. Our Affiliate & Creator Marketing Manager is responsible for growing that creator engine to 5,000+ active creators posting monthly and increasing the percentage of affiliate videos generating sales. Your job is to make sure creator activity, paid media, organic content, product presentation, and e-commerce strategy translate into profitable business results.




What You'll Oversee (Key Responsibilities)

1) TikTok Shop Growth (Primary Focus)

Analyze GMV, revenue, sales, conversion, traffic, product performance, and creator-generated revenue to identify what is working and where opportunities exist.
Develop and execute strategies to increase daily sales and GMV. Test products, content, offers, campaigns, positioning, and channel strategies.
Follow TikTok Shop updates, trends, tools, features, and best practices. Identify underused opportunities and be first to test them.
Monitor results, improve conversion and product presentation, and work with the Affiliate & Creator Marketing Manager to determine what should be scaled.
Build repeatable processes that make TikTok Shop growth more scalable.




2) Paid Media & Digital Marketing

You should be comfortable managing, analyzing, and improving paid performance, not simply reviewing reports.

Manage and/or oversee paid campaigns across Meta and TikTok aligned with revenue and profitability goals.
Analyze ROAS, CPA, CPC, CTR, conversion rate, AOV, and revenue contribution. Identify whether problems come from targeting, creative, offer, product, landing page, or conversion.
Recommend budget changes and determine which campaigns or audiences should be scaled, reduced, paused, or restructured.
Develop creative tests across hooks, messaging, offers, formats, products, and concepts. Identify organic or creator content that can be repurposed for paid.
Connect paid media with TikTok Shop, e-commerce, organic content, and creator performance.




3) E-Commerce Growth & Conversion Optimization

Review the customer journey from ad/content → product page → checkout → purchase and identify where customers drop off.
Analyze product-level traffic, conversion, add-to-cart rate, AOV, and sales. Identify underperforming products, pages, offers, campaigns, and customer objections.
Review Shopify product pages and landing pages, including images, videos, headlines, descriptions, pricing, CTAs, and messaging. Ensure advertising and product-page messaging are aligned.
Develop conversion-focused landing page tests. Evaluate TikTok Shop product presentation and Amazon product creative/content.
Use customer questions, reviews, comments, objections, and behavior to identify opportunities and test improvements to presentation, messaging, creative, and offers.




4) Creative Strategy & Content Performance

We want a marketer who understands why creative works and how it drives business results, not simply someone who reports views and engagement.

Analyze TikTok, Instagram, Meta, creator, and paid creative to understand what captures attention and contributes to conversions.
Develop hooks, angles, concepts, messaging, and creative testing strategies based on audience behavior and business performance.
Turn customer pain points, product benefits, reviews, objections, and questions into content opportunities.
Develop TikTok and Instagram content strategies and identify winning creator content that can be replicated, expanded, or scaled.
Create content briefs and provide actionable creative direction to creators and internal teams.
Connect organic, creator, paid, and e-commerce performance to build repeatable creative frameworks.




5) Creative Execution

We want a marketer who can execute, not just strategize. You do not need to be an expert designer or professional video editor, but you should have enough hands-on ability to make or modify content when needed.

You may be expected to:

Make simple edits to images, graphics, and marketing assets.
Edit short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram, and other social channels.
Add or modify text, captions, hooks, CTAs, and other creative elements.
Adapt creative for different platforms, formats, or campaigns.
Create basic social and marketing assets when needed.

Experience with Photoshop, CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Canva, or similar tools is valuable.




6) Data, KPIs & Performance

You should be comfortable tracking:

Revenue, GMV, orders, traffic, AOV, and conversion rate
Product-level conversion and add-to-cart rate
CTR, CPC, CPA, CAC, and ROAS
Creator-generated revenue, retention, and engagement
Contribution margin and overall profitability




The goal is not simply to report numbers. You should be able to answer: What is happening? Why? What should we change? What happened after we changed it? Most importantly, did we make money?




You should understand that reported ROI is not profit and account for commissions, referral fees, advertising spend, discounts, shipping, product costs, and other expenses when evaluating profitability.




7) Testing, Growth & Cross-Channel Marketing

Understand how TikTok Shop, paid media, organic content, creators, Shopify, Amazon, Meta, and other channels work together.

Continuously test content angles, hooks, offers, product positioning, creative formats, landing pages, audiences, campaigns, and other growth levers.
Use insights from paid media, creators, TikTok Shop, e-commerce, and customer data to improve strategy across channels.
Identify winning creative, messaging, products, and concepts that can be adapted or scaled across channels.
Research competitors, trends, platforms, and emerging opportunities.
Identify customer-journey gaps and where additional investment could have the greatest impact.
Stop strategies and tests that are not producing results and shift resources toward stronger opportunities.
Document successful tests and learnings so what works can be repeated and scaled.




What We're Looking For

Must-haves:

3+ years of experience in digital marketing, e-commerce, growth marketing, performance marketing, paid media, TikTok Shop, or a related field.
Strong understanding of digital marketing, e-commerce, short-form content, social commerce, and customer psychology.
Hands-on experience with paid advertising, particularly Meta Ads and/or TikTok Ads.
Strong analytical ability and experience turning performance data into decisions.
Strong understanding of e-commerce conversion and the customer journey.
Experience testing and optimizing campaigns rather than simply managing them.
Highly independent and comfortable figuring things out without step-by-step direction.
Margin literacy. You understand that ROI is not profit and can account for commissions, referral fees, discounts, shipping, and product cost.
Comfortable testing, learning, adjusting, and moving quickly.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.




What You Get:

Performance-based bonuses tied to measurable results.
Fully remote role with flexible hours.
Free TopFoxx products.
Paid time off and company holidays.

Time Doctor is a time-tracking and productivity tool that records hours worked and takes periodic screenshots while the timer is running. For this full-time role, it is used to verify and track the expected 8-hour workday.

description:
About the job

At Jellyfish we believe that our individual differences are our greatest assets. We are passionate about empowering every employee to reach their full potential and contribute their unique perspectives to our collaborative environment. We are an equal opportunity employer and firmly believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce drives innovation and leads to better solutions. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other personal characteristics that make them who they are.

Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly analytical and creative-minded Creative Intelligence Analyst to join our team. This role is designed to bridge the gap between media performance and creative production. You will be responsible for dissecting creative performance data to understand why certain ads perform better than others, translating those insights into actionable strategies for our creative and media teams. You will work closely with our Creative/Pencil Lead and Media Buyers to optimize our creative output based on rigorous data analysis.

Key Responsibilities


 Creative Performance Analysis & Reporting
Analyze the performance of creative assets across various platforms (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, etc.) to identify winning patterns and elements.
Evaluate creative components such as hooks, visuals, copy, and CTAs to determine their impact on key performance indicators (KPIs) like CTR, CPA, and ROAS.
Build and maintain comprehensive dashboards and reports that focus specifically on creative efficacy.
 Strategic Bridge & Briefing
Act as the primary liaison between the Media/Data teams and the Creative/Production teams.
Translate media performance data into creative "lessons learned" and actionable creative briefs for future production.
Collaborate with the Creative/Pencil Lead to integrate AI-driven insights into the creative workflow.
 Testing & Optimization Frameworks
Develop and manage a robust creative testing roadmap, including A/B testing and multivariate testing protocols.
Provide data-backed recommendations for creative iterations and optimizations.
Oversee the metadata tagging process for creative assets to ensure granular data collection and analysis.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration
Participate in regular cross-departmental syncs to align creative production with media buying strategies.
Educate the creative team on performance metrics and how their work impacts the bottom line.
Stay ahead of industry trends and platform updates to ensure our creative strategies remain cutting-edge.


Requirements & Skills

Experience: 3-5 years of experience in media analysis, digital marketing, or a performance-driven creative role. Advanced English proficiency. 

Analytical Skills: Proficiency in data analysis tools (Excel, SQL, Google Data Studio, Tableau) and platform native analytics.

Platform Knowledge: Deep understanding of Paid Social and Programmatic ads platforms

Creative Intuition: A strong grasp of storytelling, visual design principles, and what resonates with audiences on social media.

Tool Proficiency: Experience with AI-driven creative tools (e.g., Pencil) and creative management platforms is highly desirable.

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

Additional Information

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

💰 Savings fund: You'll save 5% of your monthly income and Jellyfish will contribute the same amount you save to your savings fund.

💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am. and 6:30pm with flexible working hours.

🏥 Health Insurance: We provide a private health insurance policy that includes visual and dental plan coverage.

Unfortunately, there has been an increase in fake recruiters impersonating Jellyfish and unlawfully using our brand name. If you are unsure if an email with a job offer you have received is genuinely from Jellyfish, or if you suspect any fraudulent activity, please report it to talentacquisition@jellyfish.com.

skills: Own the local customer engagement strategy for assigned brand(s), translating Takeda's central brand strategy and modular content into a locally executable plan.
Design the customer journey and orchestrate omnichannel engagement across field and non-personal channels, managing local investment on an ROI basis.
Feed performance, market and customer insights back to Marketing & Customer Excellence (MCE) to shape future brand strategy and content.
Deliver local brand performance — market competitiveness

Local situational analysis and customer insight — understand local customer needs, barriers, journey and competitive context to ground the engagement strategy (engagement-focused, not brand re-strategizing).

Own the Local Engagement Plan — the core deliverable an all-channel, all-tactic plan covering audiences / segments, objectives, channel mix and sequencing, module selection rationale, budget allocation, enablement needs, measurement plan and learning agenda. Develop it with cross-functional input and buy-in.

Design the local customer journey and experience — own the local HCP / customer journey across touchpoints within the overall journey framework set centrally by Marketing Execution, and optimize engagement quality, not just channel activity.

Set engagement objectives across channels — define goals, target audiences, key messages and content needs across face-to-face 1 1 (field / KAM), face-to-face many-to-many (meetings, congresses, events, advisory boards) and digital / non-personal channels.

Brief and train field teams on brand messaging — equip field / KAM teams with the brand messaging and narrative and train them on message delivery; the Sales Lead owns the rest of field-team management, coaching and delivery.

Sustain key-customer engagement and market proximity — act as a visible local point of contact for priority customers, maintain direct personal contact, and keep a first-hand read on the local market, competitor activity and unmet needs to inform engagement and MCE-developed strategy.

Orchestrate cross-functional engagement — convene and direct commercial, medical and access partners around the engagement plan; lead or co-lead (with Medical) the local cross-functional engagement team to drive buy-in, shared processes and commitment, coordinating cadence and sequencing while respecting compliance processes and SOPs.

Reuse-first modular content — brief for modular components rather than full campaigns, trust central content as the foundation, localize only where required within approved claims and business rules, and run efficient local MLR; provide clear requirements to the MCE Campaign Design Lead (Marketing Execution).
Data, analytics and AI-enabled orchestration — interpret omnichannel performance data; work with next-best-action / decision engines and CRM; use AI to support content adaptation and personalization.
Manage and optimize local engagement investment — own the local activity budget (meetings, congresses, events) and allocate it on an ROI basis across channels toward the highest-impact engagement.
Hand off to MCE Campaign Activation Lead (Marketing Execution) provide a deployment-ready package (success metrics, timelines, owners, approvals) and align readiness gates and monitoring.
Close the loop — convert performance data into next-wave optimization and feed structured insight, content / module gaps and recommendations back to MCE.
Work within Marketing Excellence and Commercial Capabilities — apply the engagement methods, frameworks, playbooks and process standards they set.
Relevant degree (e.g., life sciences, marketing or business); advanced qualification an advantage.
Extensive pharmaceutical/healthcare marketing, customer engagement or omnichannel activation.
Experience localizing central strategy and content and orchestrating cross-functional, omnichannel engagement.
Data, analytics and AI fluency; modular-content and MLR literacy with a reuse-first mindset.
Experience managing activity budgets within compliance/MLR processes; agile, test-and-learn ways of working.
Role-models Takeda's six culture pillars Patient-Centric, People-Minded, Respectful & Collaborative, Decision Effectiveness, Performance Culture and Enterprise Orientation.
Competitive salary + annual performance bonus
Monthly restaurant and meal vouchers
Flexible work arrangements
Comprehensive Healthcare Medical, Dental, and Vision
Among other benefits

About the job

En Tagma Full Agency buscamos incorporar a una persona con experiencia en BTL, eventos, activaciones y experiencias de marca que quiera participar activamente en la generación y desarrollo de nuevas oportunidades de negocio.




Buscamos una combinación particular: alguien con actitud comercial y orientación a resultados, pero que también conozca la lógica operativa del sector para conversar con clientes, interpretar un brief, construir una propuesta y coordinar información con proveedores y especialistas.




Para esta posición es indispensable contar con experiencia profesional directa en BTL, eventos, activaciones, experiencias de marca, producción o disciplinas estrechamente relacionadas.




No buscamos necesariamente una trayectoria extensa ni un perfil de alta jerarquía. Nos interesa una persona con buenos fundamentos, iniciativa, criterio, capacidad de aprendizaje y potencial para crecer junto con la agencia.




¿Qué harás?

Identificar y desarrollar nuevas oportunidades mediante prospección directa, referencias, contactos existentes y leads generados por Tagma.
Participar en reuniones con prospectos y clientes, comprender necesidades y dar seguimiento a briefs y solicitudes.
Colaborar en propuestas para eventos, activaciones, montajes, ambientaciones y otras experiencias de marca.
Solicitar y dar seguimiento a cotizaciones de proveedores junto con el equipo interno y especialistas de producción.
Acompañar cada oportunidad desde su detección hasta el cierre comercial.
Contribuir al desarrollo de relaciones de largo plazo y nuevas oportunidades en cuentas existentes.




La posición tiene un foco comercial. No esperamos que produzcas directamente los proyectos, pero sí que comprendas sus componentes y puedas conversar productivamente con quienes estarán a cargo de su implementación.




¿Qué buscamos?

Más que un número determinado de años, nos interesa la pertinencia de tu trayectoria y el potencial que puedas aportar.




Valoraremos especialmente experiencia en desarrollo o atención de clientes, prospección, propuestas, cotizaciones, coordinación de proveedores y procesos comerciales dentro de BTL, eventos, activaciones, experiencias de marca o servicios relacionados.




La experiencia comercial en otros sectores puede ser valiosa, pero para esta búsqueda necesitamos que esté acompañada por experiencia directa en este tipo de proyectos o servicios.




También valoraremos tu comunicación, organización, seguimiento, iniciativa, criterio y forma profesional de relacionarte con clientes, proveedores y equipo. PowerPoint, Excel, CRM y un nivel funcional de inglés serán considerados de manera integral.




¿Cómo es trabajar con nosotros?

Tagma es una agencia de comunicación, marketing y contenidos con un equipo compacto y multidisciplinario. Este rol tendrá interacción cercana con Dirección, gestión de proyectos, equipo creativo y partners especializados.




Nos interesa alguien que valore un entorno con espacio para involucrarse, aprender, proponer y construir, donde la excelencia, el enfoque a soluciones, la actitud de servicio, la integridad y la adaptabilidad forman parte de nuestra manera de trabajar.




La posición está orientada a personas en Ciudad de México y su área metropolitana, con disponibilidad para reuniones, visitas, eventos y otras actividades presenciales cuando el trabajo lo requiera.




Consideramos inicialmente una modalidad híbrida y un esquema de dedicación parcial, con compensación fija más un componente variable vinculado a resultados.




Si tienes experiencia en este sector y te interesa desarrollar nuevas oportunidades de negocio desde una perspectiva cercana al cliente y a la operación, nos interesa conocerte.




Postúlate a través de LinkedIn adjuntando tu CV actualizado.

description:
About the job

Who We Are

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

The Opportunity

Are you a data-driven lifecycle marketer with a passion for customer engagement and the technical chops to strengthen and scale customer lifecycle marketing capabilities? We're looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to join our powerhouse team and lead lifecycle strategy and execution across Oportun's product ecosystem and key member moments. You will define and execute programs across email, push, SMS, in-app, and emerging channels to drive activation, engagement, retention, product adoption, and long-term customer value.

You are responsible for both strategy and execution. This includes prioritizing lifecycle initiatives across products, ensuring campaigns run reliably, and continuously improving performance through testing, segmentation, personalization, and marketing technology enhancements. You will work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, Marketing, and Marketing Technology to deliver timely, compliant, and effective communications. You will also manage dependencies, resolve blockers, and translate business needs into clear data, platform, and execution requirements.

This role will also help advance Oportun's CLM technology capabilities. You will identify and implement opportunities such as new channel expansion, custom event integrations, improved customer data flows, AI-assisted campaign workflows, and automation that makes the CLM program more scalable, personalized, and efficient.

Success in this role means improving key lifecycle metrics across products, building scalable systems, strengthening CLM platform capabilities, and ensuring lifecycle marketing is a reliable, tech-enabled growth lever for the business.

If you're a hands-on marketer with a passion for strategic thinking, lifecycle marketing execution, data-driven decision-making, marketing technology, and customer engagement, we'd love to hear from you.

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day


You’ll own and optimize the lifecycle roadmap across onboarding, activation, engagement, retention, product adoption, and cross-product growth.
You’ll build, launch, and optimize multi-channel campaigns across email, push, SMS, in-app, and emerging channels.
You’ll use customer data, behavioral signals, product events, segmentation, and personalization to deliver timely and relevant member experiences.
You’ll design and improve automated lifecycle journeys that support onboarding, activation, feature adoption, servicing, engagement, and retention.
You’ll lead structured experimentation, including A/B and holdout testing, to measure incremental impact and improve performance.
You’ll partner with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Data, Design, Content, Legal, Compliance, and Marketing Technology to align priorities and deliver new capabilities.
You’ll translate lifecycle needs into clear technical requirements, event definitions, data requirements, use cases, and implementation priorities.
You’ll help advance Oportun’s CLM technology capabilities through new channels, custom events, improved data flows, platform enhancements, and automation.
You’ll identify and resolve gaps in data, tooling, integrations, or workflows that limit campaign performance or execution.
You’ll ensure campaigns meet high standards for QA, deliverability, consent management, data integrity, privacy, compliance, and member experience.
You’ll bring ideas for how we can do things better, proactively, not just when asked.
You’ll look for practical ways to use AI to improve campaign development, analysis, personalization, QA, reporting, and workflow efficiency.


Who You Are

The right fit looks like this

You’re a customer-focused lifecycle marketer who is equally comfortable thinking strategically and getting into the details of execution. You combine strong marketing judgment with data, technology, and experimentation to improve member experiences and business outcomes.

You’re proactive, accountable, and comfortable navigating ambiguity. You know how to influence across teams, translate business needs into actionable requirements, and maintain a high bar for quality in a regulated environment.

What You Bring

Required

About the job

By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. Learn more at www.circana.com.

At the heart of our commercial success is a team of professionals who combine strategic insight, customer-centricity, and executional excellence. These skills represent the core capabilities required to drive value for our clients and sustainable growth for our business.


Effectively Presents Solutions: Delivers tailored, compelling solutions that align with customer needs and drive action.

Being Resilient: Bounces back from setbacks with composure and positivity; helps others stay productive during tough times. 
Manages Ambiguity: Stays focused and calm in uncertain situations; guides others through change. 


What will you be doing? 

This internship is designed for students to get hands-on, real-world experience working with a Client Development Team. The internship is for rising year 3 students, interested in pursuing a career in Insights, Analytics, CPG, Retail, Gen Merch or Market Research post-graduation.

Circana offers a full program to ensure ALL our associates gain:


Knowledge about the industry we exist in and the clients we serve. 
Experience working on active projects that have actual impact on our business. 
Training on technical tools and behavioral skills that are critical to an employee’s success. 
Networking and mentor opportunities that can create personal connections. 


Job Responsibilities


Support a team responsible for helping a General Merchandise client (or multiple clients) understand their performance relative to the market and identify opportunities to grow their business and share of the market. 
Understand how to leverage Circana analytics to address clients’ business challenges and market opportunities. 
Translate data into actionable, analytic insights to drive Circana’s clients’ business performance. 
Shadow client meetings to present market research and insights. 
At Circana lateral, promotional, and cross-functional moves are encouraged and part of our culture. While your initial role will be in one of these groups, you’ll have the chance to grow your career both within your initial assignment and into other opportunities that meet your career goals. 


Requirements


Pursuing a Bachelor’s Degree required in Marketing, Business, Engineering, Data Analytics, or related field with a quantitative component, expecting to graduate between June 2027 and December 2027. 
Experience in or knowledge of the Retail or CPG industry preferred (e.g., School projects, case study, or relevant work experience). 
Academic knowledge/coursework in finance, economics, statistics, marketing or marketing analytics, data visualization, and/or logic is preferred. 
Strong intellectual curiosity and critical thinking ability, relentless attention to detail, strong written/verbal communication, ability to work collaboratively on a team, etc. 
Familiarity with Excel and PowerPoint is a plus but not essential. Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense, etc.)
Technology aptitude and willingness to learn and work on new solutions and platforms. 
Creative problem-solving skills, ability to frame a business problem, design and execute an analysis plan, and understand and synthesize data findings into business insights and translate into creative data visualizations. 


Circana Behaviors

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviors sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviors throughout the business within their day-to-day role:


Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. 
Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. 
Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. 
Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. 
Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. 
Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. 
Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 


Location 

This position can be located in the following area(s): Hybrid, Mexico City, Mexico

About the job

About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

Location: Fully remote from Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Mexico, Argentina and Colombia only - supporting a team in the EST time zone.

About The Role

We are looking for a sharp, fast, brand-obsessed Retention Specialist to own the voice of a high-growth consumer technology client. You will write the email and SMS copy that carries the program, direct the creative that goes with it, and keep the marketing calendar moving as output scales.

You are writing a program into existence rather than maintaining one. The list starts near 20,000 and grows fast behind a significant acquisition investment, volume ramps to 40–60 emails a month, and deepening segmentation multiplies the number of versions behind every send. Most of what you write is automated — lead capture, welcome series, first-conversion and activation sequences — and then loyalty and repeat purchase programming on top of it. The program runs on enterprise tooling such as Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, or Customer.io.

This is a copy-led role. You will write more than you manage, and the quality of your writing is the primary thing we are hiring for. The ability to hold a consistent voice across a lot of output is essential.

You should apply if this sounds like you

You are a copywriter who happens to work in lifecycle marketing. You can explain a technical product simply, write a subject line that earns the open, and make a subscription upgrade feel like a good idea rather than a sales pitch.


3–5+ years of experience writing marketing copy, with meaningful time in email, SMS, or lifecycle marketing. A strong portfolio matters as much as the years. 
You write excellent short-form copy — subject lines, preheaders, body, CTAs, SMS — and you can show work where your copy moved a number. 
You can make consumer technology, software, or a digital subscription feel clear and desirable without jargon. Experience writing for a SaaS, app, or connected-device brand is a strong plus. 
You have written the funnel: lead capture and opt-in copy, welcome series, first-conversion and onboarding sequences, and subscription activation messaging. 
You have written loyalty, rewards, and win-back programming, and you understand that driving repeat purchase and long-term value is a core outcome of this role. 
You are comfortable working from a segmentation strategy, writing distinct copy for distinct audiences rather than one message for everyone. 
You can direct design. You write clear creative briefs, give specific and useful feedback on layout, hierarchy, and imagery, and you know when a design is not serving the copy. 
You are fluent in Figma — you review and approve designs there, leave actionable comments, and keep versions straight. 
You own a marketing calendar with confidence: you can hold a high-volume calendar, flag conflicts early, and keep a lot of moving pieces on schedule. 
You are detail-obsessed about proofing, links, personalization tokens, and brand consistency. Typos in a send genuinely bother you. 
You take feedback well and iterate quickly, and you are comfortable presenting and defending your creative choices to a client. 
Working knowledge of an enterprise ESP (Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, Customer.io, or comparable) is a plus; you do not need to be the one building, but you should understand what is possible. 


A day in the life


Write the email and SMS copy for campaigns, flows, and automations across your client's program, from lead capture through activation, loyalty, and repeat purchase. 
Develop and maintain the client's marketing calendar, sequencing campaigns against the strategy your Associate Director sets and flagging capacity risks before they become problems. 
Write creative briefs for the design team and give clear, specific direction on what each asset needs to do. 
Review and approve designs in Figma, leaving actionable feedback and shepherding assets to final. 
Own the brand voice and the copy guidelines for your client, keeping tone consistent as output scales and segmentation multiplies the number of versions. 
Partner with the CRM Specialist to make sure copy, segmentation logic, and dynamic content line up in the build. 
Proof every send before it goes out — copy, links, personalization, rendering. 
Review performance with your Associate Director and translate what you learn into your next round of copy tests. 


What It's Like to Work at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.


Unlimited PTO + Local holidays (Relevant to your hub): Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp. 
Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain. 
Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition. 
Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry. 


Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Experience in marketing technology or advertising technology is beneficial.

At Smartly, we offer a place where you can advance your career. Here, you'll find:

An Inclusive Global Culture: Join a team of over 750 Smartlies, representing more than 60 nationalities across 24 locations in 13 countries. We cultivate a culture built on trust, transparency, and open feedback, where diverse perspectives are valued and encouraged.

Global Impact: Contribute to a company making a global impact, directly influencing our customers' success and business growth.

Focus on Wellbeing: We prioritize your health with healthcare packages, mental health services, and a commitment to work-life balance through paid holidays and family leave.

Comprehensive Rewards: Benefit from equity options, performance-based rewards, competitive compensation, and career development opportunities.

Apply Now and Build Your Future with Smartly!

About the job

Paystand is the world's leading blockchain-enabled B2B payments network, transforming commercial finance into a software-driven, zero-fee, and open ecosystem. Recognized as a CNBC/Statista 2026 World's Top Fintech company, Paystand delivers over a decade of on-chain payments experience to middle and large enterprises.

Paystand's network services more than one million payors that have moved $20+ billion in volume. With its acquisitions of Yaydoo, Teampay and Bitwage, Paystand's full-stack platform includes agentic AI, its USDb stablecoin, and AR/AP solutions on one tightly integrated network. Its non-profit arm, Paystand.org, advances the mission to democratize finance through Bitcoin and blockchain technology.

What We Do

We built the financial system we always thought should exist: zero fees, zero friction, just your money, faster. Blockchain automates receivables and payables, cuts time-to-cash, and turns every transaction into revenue instead of cost.

Why We Do It

The current system takes a cut from the people who build, create, and grow — and calls it the cost of doing business. We don't buy that. Every fee we eliminate compounds into growth. We're here to decentralize finance and hand the power back to the businesses driving the real economy — extended further through Paystand.org's work to democratize finance through Bitcoin and blockchain.

How We Do It

We don't wait for permission or for the industry to catch up — we build the future of finance ourselves, on-chain, in the open. Small moves now, monumental results later.
